nodes.label: .`after a normal start the persisted session alone says what to restore`()
.`a process death between execute and release still restores the utility it turned on`()
.`two utilities in one cue each restore their own`()
.`an obligation recorded before args existed ends CLEANUP_PENDING, never COMPLETED`()
.`an old-shape session with none of the new fields still decodes, as NONE and null`()
.`an executor that never adopted the obligation overload releases exactly as before`()
